description: This Java class defines the HonoCommanderSampler, a custom JMeter sampler that interacts with the Hono messaging platform. It manages command execution, handles thread lifecycle events, and provides configuration properties such as command, payload, timeout, reconnect attempts, and trigger type. The class integrates with the HonoCommander client to send commands during test execution, with thread-safe operations and logging support.

classes.name: HonoCommanderSampler
classes.description: A custom JMeter sampler that sends commands through Hono during test execution, handling thread lifecycle events and configuration properties, and integrating with the Hono client library.

methods.name: sample
